You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Based on user's goal/request, you may
- Answer back if the request/goal is a question (or a chat message), like user asks "What is my schedule for today?".
- Complete some tasks described in the requests/goals by performing actions (step by step) on the phone.

When given a user request, you will try to complete it step by step. At each step, a list of descriptions for most UI elements on the current screen will be given to you (each element can be specified by an index), together with a history of what you have done in previous steps. Based on these pieces of information and the goal, you must choose to perform one of the action in the following list (action description followed by the JSON format) by outputing the action in the correct JSON format.
- If you think the task has been completed, finish the task by using the status action with complete as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "complete"}`
- If you think the task is not feasible (including cases like you don't have enough information or can not perform some necessary actions), finish by using the `status` action with infeasible as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "infeasible"}`
- Answer user's question: `{"action_type": "answer", "text": "<answer_text>"}`
- Click/tap on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "click", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Long press on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "long_press", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Type text into an editable text field (specified by its index), this action contains clicking the text field, typing in the text and pressing the enter, so no need to click on the target field to start: `{"action_type": "input_text", "text": <text_input>, "index": <target_index>}`
- Press the Enter key: `{"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}`
- Navigate to the home screen: `{"action_type": "navigate_home"}`
- Navigate back: `{"action_type": "navigate_back"}`
- Scroll the screen or a scrollable UI element in one of the four directions, use the same numeric index as above if you want to scroll a specific UI element, leave it empty when scroll the whole screen: `{"action_type": "scroll", "direction": <up, down, left, right>, "index": <optional_target_index>}`
- Open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed): `{"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": <name>}`
- Wait for the screen to update: `{"action_type": "wait"}`

The current user goal/request is: Create a playlist in Retro Music titled "Blues Break 158" with the following songs, in order: Mystic Journey, Orbiting Stars, Serenity Now

Here is a history of what you have done so far:
Step 1: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Retro Music"}. Opened the Retro Music app from the home screen to begin creating a playlist titled "Blues Break 158"; the launcher screen was replaced, indicating the app is loading as expected.
Step 2: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 9}. Clicked the Playlists tab (index 9) in the Retro Music bottom navigation. Successfully navigated to the Playlists screen which shows "You have no playlists". Next, I need to tap the "More options" button (or find a create/add playlist option) to create a new playlist titled "Blues Break 158".
Step 3: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Tapped "More options" on the Playlists tab in Retro Music; a menu appeared with options including "New playlist", "Import playlist", "Grid size", "Sort order", and "Settings". Next, I should click "New playlist" to create the playlist.
Step 4: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 2}. Clicked "New playlist" from the menu; a dialog appeared with a "Playlist name" text field and Cancel/Create buttons. Next, I should input "Blues Break 158" into the text field and click Create.
Step 5: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "Blues Break 158", "index": 1}. Typed "Blues Break 158" into the Playlist name field in the New playlist dialog; the field now shows the entered name. Next I should tap the "Create" button (index 3) to create the playlist, then add songs Mystic Journey, Orbiting Stars, Serenity Now in order.
Step 6: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 3}. Clicked "Create" button to create the playlist "Blues Break 158"; it worked as the Playlists screen now shows the new empty playlist "Blues Break 158" (0 Songs). Next, I need to add songs Mystic Journey, Orbiting Stars, and Serenity Now in order, likely via the Songs tab.
Step 7: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 5}. Clicked the "Songs" tab in the bottom navigation to browse the song list; successfully navigated to Songs view showing tracks including Mystic Journey and Orbiting Stars visible on screen. Serenity Now is not yet visible—may need to scroll down. Next, I should long-press or use the menu on each target song (Mystic Journey, Orbiting Stars, Serenity Now in order) to add them to the "Blues Break 158" playlist.
Step 8: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 40}. Clicked the menu (three-dot) icon next to "Mystic Journey" at index 40 to open its options menu for adding to playlist, but the screenshot appears unchanged - the popup menu may not have appeared yet or the click didn't register; may need to wait or retry.
Step 9: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 43}. Attempted to click the menu icon (index 43) next to "Mystic Journey" to open its options menu for adding to playlist, but the click instead opened the Now Playing player screen (showing "Echoes of Silence"), meaning the click was misregistered or hit the mini-player area. Need to navigate back to the Songs list and try clicking the menu icon for Mystic Journey again more carefully.
Step 10: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Navigated back to return to the Songs list to access Mystic Journey's menu, but the screen appears unchanged (still showing the same Now Playing view with song list below); may need to try navigate_back again or use a different approach to reach the main Songs list.
Step 11: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Pressed back to collapse the Now Playing full screen view; now on Retro Music home screen with bottom navigation visible (For you, Songs, Albums, Artists, Playlists). Next, tap "Playlists" to create the new playlist "Blues Break 158".
Step 12: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 6}. Clicked on the "Songs" tab (index 6) in the bottom navigation to browse songs, but the screenshot appears unchanged (still showing the "For you" home screen) — the click may not have registered; should retry clicking the Songs tab or try a different approach like navigating to Playlists first to create the playlist before adding songs.
